text: Bonsoir. I'm the grandfather, I have my petite-fille tonight, she is 12 months. Her temperature is 38.1. Her eye is pink and sticky since this morning. But what worries me, there are small dark spots on her. Her skin is dark so c'est difficile à voir, so I looked on the palms of her hands and the soles of her feet, and inside her bottom eyelid, and I can see little red-purple dots there too. I pressed a glass on them like my daughter showed me and they do not go away, ils restent là. I am very tired, I don't know if I'm seeing things properly anymore.
